description: Atlas evidence: submit one Atlas stage: wrapper, issuer-sponsored or native. The signed brief lists every asset the published dataset classifies at that stage with its classification basis and the six rights fields (issuer involvement, custody and backing, distributions, voting, legal status, redemption), each marked disclosed or not disclosed, with per-field and total counts beside the catalog stage count. A stage with no assets returns a signed brief with an asset count of 0. POST /api/atlas-stage-brief. Reads the published Tokenization Atlas dataset at https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets once per call, the same read the Atlas evidence tools make, with no dataset writes and no issuer contact. Every report names the dataset version it read, and a field the dataset does not hold is reported as not in the published dataset. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/atlas-board-contract. Human page: https://atlas.weverlabs.com/.

stage.description: One Atlas taxonomy stage: wrapper (stage 1), issuer-sponsored (stage 2) or native (stage 3, native issuance).
